The Court made the following:
 3  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE B.V.L.N.CHAKRAVARTHI  WRIT PETITION No.4521 OF 2019 ORDER:
Heard learned counsel representing Sri N.Ashwani Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri R.Mallikarjuna Rao, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.
2. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home on written instructions would submit that police completed investigation in Crime No.149 of 2019 of Machavaram Police Station of Vijayawada City, for the offence under Sections 376(2)(N), 417 and 506 IPC and laid charge sheet in S.C.No.77 of 2021 on 27.11.2020, pending the writ petition and therefore, no further orders are required in the writ petition.
3. The writ petition was filed contending that police not investigating into the above crime.
4.
Now, the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home would disclose that police completed investigation, and laid charge sheet before the concerned Court.
5. In that view of the matter, the Writ Petition has become infructuous.
6. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, interlocutory applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
